verdict.rationale: Browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence shows no Authenticator browser extension. The docs describe users manually entering the code they see in the app. The only autofill in the evidence covered passwords, not TOTP or passkeys; community reports say it is being discontinued, with the role moving to Edge, a separate product.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
